subject.title: Feature: fallbackChannel for hook mappings when primary delivery fails

question: Should hook delivery support automatic cross-channel failover, and if so which destination types, failure classes, and audience/account boundaries are permitted?
rationale: Source confirms the capability is missing, but code alone cannot decide whether automatically moving externally triggered content between channels is acceptable or how duplicate-send and trust-boundary risks should be handled.

options.title: Explicit ordered routes
options.body: Add opt-in fully qualified fallback routes with definitive-failure classification, policy checks, deduplication, and delivery-status reporting.

options.title: Failure notification only
options.body: Keep one response destination and expose a separately configured route that receives only a delivery-failure notification.

options.title: No automatic failover
options.body: Retain single-destination hook delivery and require operators or agents to implement alternate sends explicitly.

recommendation.title: Explicit ordered routes
recommendation.body: Add opt-in fully qualified fallback routes with definitive-failure classification, policy checks, deduplication, and delivery-status reporting.

likelyOwner.reason: They already reviewed this exact request and are the strongest available product-routing signal for Gateway configuration and delivery semantics.
